card.name: Digits inside citation ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long reference number, such as a PubMed ID, DOI, ISBN or article page code, in a citation or reference list.

modes.label: Article IDs
modes.description: A digit inside a journal page code, DOI or PubMed number.
modes.example: ins CH, Wilson ME; Klinefelter's syndrome. BMJ. 2012 Dec 3;345:e7<<5>>58. doi: 10

modes.label: Book ISBN
modes.description: A digit inside or near the end of an ISBN.
modes.example: to Children About Art written by Francoise Barbe-Galle Frances Lincoln | ISBN 9780711223<<8>>82 Member’s price: $
